headline: BDDK Transfers Management of Adil Katılım Bankası to TMSF
summary: Turkey's Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK) decided to transfer the management, supervision, and partnership rights—excluding dividends—of Adil Katılım Bankası to the Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF).
why: Regulatory interventions transferring troubled financial institutions to state insurance funds protect depositors and maintain systemic banking sector stability.
